title: Noisy p3-PPT certification by purified replicas
difficulty_explanation: Each case is a 64-qubit purified state, so dense purification and density-matrix routes are impossible. The solver must preserve logical-neighbor semantics in an interleaved system/environment MPS, apply seeded local Stinespring noise, contract two replicas for p2, contract three replicas with opposite cycles on scrambled A/B sites for p3, and distinguish positive from nonpositive p2^2-p3 margins across coupled and PPT-control cases.
solution_explanation: The expert uses TensorCircuit MPSCircuit with exact adjacent SWAP shuttles for the logical system gates, applies one environment-qubit Stinespring dilation per system site, reads the public MPS tensors, and evaluates gauge-invariant two- and three-replica transfers using TensorCircuit backend einsum.
verification_explanation: The evaluator never imports TensorCircuit. It independently implements complex128 canonical NumPy MPS evolution, the same unitary Stinespring dilation, and explicit two-/three-replica transfers. A separately evolved dense eight-qubit canary traces the environments, forms the partial transpose, and compares direct matrix powers against both replica contractions.
relevant_experience: This reserve combines exact MPS gauge motion, Stinespring purification of local channels, partial-transpose moment identities, opposite replica permutations, and one-sided entanglement certification.

contract.determinism_scope: Exact case bytes are bound by the pinned image/runtime and evaluator-emitted case_digest; a seed alone is not a cross-NumPy case identity.
contract.case_seed_source: verifier-only ORBIT_Q_CANDIDATE_SEED or evaluator --seed for local canaries
contract.hidden_holdout_status: pending; local host digests are non-binding canaries and no pinned-image private holdout has been frozen
contract.anti_hardcoding: The seed changes the ordered mix of coupled and PPT-control cases, initial excitations, A/B partitions, complex circuit gates, local damping rates, opaque case IDs, and nonces. Exact p2, p3, gaps, and classifications are all scored.
contract.oracle: Independent NumPy canonical MPS/TEBD plus explicit two-/three-replica transfers and a separate dense partial-transpose canary

seed_protocol.base_seed_mapping: The single base seed initializes one NumPy Generator stream that emits the ordered three-case robust ensemble, including two coupled cases and one factorized PPT control.
seed_protocol.determinism_scope: Exact public case bytes are deterministic under the pinned runtime and are identified by the evaluator-emitted case_digest.
seed_protocol.case_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, and no NaN over the exact public configuration before case_digest is added; functional stdout emits the full case_digest and protocol_seed in one structured orbit_q_case_identity JSON line.
seed_protocol.seed_scrub: The evaluator removes ORBIT_Q_CANDIDATE_SEED immediately after emitting case identity and before oracle construction or submitted-solution import.
seed_protocol.pinned_numpy_note: The target image pins NumPy 2.2.6; a seed alone is not a cross-runtime case identity, so trial manifests must bind case_digest and the pinned NumPy version.

difficulty_levers: 32 system plus 32 environment qubits rule out a dense purification, while an explicit three-copy state would contain 192 qubits
random balanced A/B labels create many switches between forward and inverse replica cycles
interleaved environments require exact logical-neighbor routing before the local Stinespring gates
complex hopping phases and |11> phases expose gate-index and conjugation mistakes
two coupled NPT cases and one rigorously factorized PPT control prevent a constant certificate
the same implementation must match p2, p3, their nonlinear gap identity, and the thresholded certificate
the 160-line ceiling discourages a redundant simulator and leaves little room for permutation-convention errors
claim_boundary: This is a deterministic synthetic exact-moment diagnostic, not a finite-shot randomized-measurement experiment. A positive gap certifies NPT entanglement; a nonpositive gap does not prove separability in general, although the generated control is PPT by construction. No pinned-image, Harbor, or solver-model trial has run, so no model-hardness claim is made.

local_static_validation.binding_status: non-binding local design canaries only; do not use these digests in a trial manifest

admission_blockers: Promote this post-shortlist reserve through explicit human review; it is a direct frozen-f06 implementation but was not one of the frozen ten review candidates.

Run the expert in the pinned TensorCircuit image and verify custom-gate orientation, exact no-truncation behavior, interleaved SWAP routing, exposed-tensor ordering, and six-index backend einsum support.
Measure expert p50/p95 runtime and peak memory on several public canary seeds under the frozen CPU/memory envelope; require p95 below 180 seconds.

Prequalify and independently freeze at least 25 private verifier-only seeds with exact pinned case_digest values, mixed certificate classes, absolute gap floors, imaginary-residual margins, bond dimensions, and oracle/expert parity before any solver trial.
Complete an authenticated expert-only Harbor functional, static-policy, and LLM-policy audit.

Human reviewers must sign the Stinespring basis convention, partial-transpose subsystem, opposite-cycle identity, p3-PPT inequality direction, one-sided certificate wording, and framework-native contraction path before promotion.
exploitability_risks: The shallow MPS is classically tractable even though dense simulation is impossible; static checks alone cannot distinguish the required TensorCircuit MPS path from a standalone implementation, so source audit remains essential.
The factorized control can be recognized from the public gate list, but exact continuous p2, p3, and gap outputs for all cases prevent a constant-classification shortcut.
Published evaluator, expert, and local canary seeds are public development evidence and cannot serve as uncontaminated private hardness evidence.
numerical_statistical_risks: Three-replica environments scale as the sixth power of MPS bond dimension; deeper circuits can abruptly exceed memory even when the qubit count is unchanged.
SVD null-rank decisions, contraction order, and floating-point roundoff can vary across NumPy/LAPACK builds; manifests must bind image, NumPy version, case_digest, and admission margins.
The p3-PPT test is sufficient but not necessary for NPT detection; benchmark labels must say certified_npt rather than entangled or separable.
This exact deterministic task has no sampling uncertainty and must not be presented as evidence for finite-shot experimental robustness.
api_risks: MPSCircuit.apply_adjacent_double_gate must preserve the rank-4 custom gate's output/input convention through both SWAP routing and damping dilation.
MPSCircuit.get_tensors may expose arbitrary gauges and center positions; both replica observables must remain gauge invariant.
The TensorCircuit backend einsum implementation must accept a rank-6 environment and six rank-3 MPS tensors without an unsupported implicit-output or contraction-path limit.
TensorCircuit backend/dtype settings are process global, and complex128 is required for the small imaginary cancellations.
NumPy Generator byte-level cases can change across versions; trial manifests must bind exact case_digest rather than treating the integer seed as complete identity.
